anticancer_bioactivity.origin_evidence: P6 was purified from the hemolymph of the species itself (Section 4.1) and sequenced de novo by nanoESI-MS/MS (Section 2.1). The published molecular weight 2794.8 Da reproduces from the sequence as 2794.56 Da with ExPASy average residue masses, which confirms the 20-mer.
anticancer_bioactivity.material_evidence: Section 4.1: the five most abundant fragments of the active HPLC peak were synthesized by GenScript (Shanghai) with solid-phase peptide synthesis, and only P6 kept the antitumour activity; purity was checked by HPLC (Figure 1C). The tested material is the chemically synthesized peptide.
anticancer_bioactivity.assay_evidence: Section 4.8: MTT assay, 1.5e3 cells per well, peptide 0-27 ug/mL for 48 h, OD at 570 nm, each concentration in at least three replicates; Table 1 reports the IC50 as mean +- SD in ug/mL.
anticancer_bioactivity.species_check: The paper prints Arca inflata Reeve; WoRMS marks it unaccepted with the accepted name Anadara broughtonii (537824 -> 504357), the same check the 3.18 AMP row for this species used. Material purchased in Qingdao, Shandong, China, lot 20190410 (Section 4.1).
anticancer_bioactivity.verification: Table 1 and Sections 2.1, 4.1 and 4.8 parsed from the Europe PMC XML of PMC8875476 on 2026-10-02. CancerPPD 2.0 holds the same values for this paper (entries 7357, 7358, 7359), an independent check of the reading.

anticancer_bioactivity.origin_evidence: The peptide was purified from the enzymatic hydrolysate of the species itself through ultrafiltration and two Sephadex LH-20 steps (Section 3.3), and its sequence GPLGAGP was read by Edman degradation and confirmed by LC-MS/MS (Section 3.4). The published m/z 567.6422 reproduces from the sequence as 567.64 Da.
anticancer_bioactivity.material_evidence: The tested material is the peptide purified from the species itself, not a synthetic copy; the paper names chemical synthesis only as a future option.
anticancer_bioactivity.assay_evidence: Section 2.6: CCK-8 assay, 4e3 cells per well, 48 h exposure, IC50 by the modified Karber method; the values are mean +- SD in mg/mL.
anticancer_bioactivity.species_check: The paper prints Enteromorpha prolifera; WoRMS marks it unaccepted (145971) with the accepted name Ulva prolifera (234476).
anticancer_bioactivity.verification: Sections 2.6, 3.3, 3.4 and Figure 3 parsed from the Europe PMC XML of PMC9657784 on 2026-10-02. CancerPPD 2.0 holds the same values for this paper (entries 7255, 7256, 7257).

anticancer_bioactivity.origin_evidence: SCH-P9 was purified from the enzymatic hydrolysate of the species itself (pepsin, the most active of the four enzymes tested) and its sequence read as Leu-Pro-Gly-Pro; reported purity 95.99%.
anticancer_bioactivity.material_evidence: Purified from the species itself, purity 95.99% by HPLC; not a synthetic copy.
anticancer_bioactivity.assay_evidence: Section MTT assay: DU-145 and PC-3 at 1e4 cells per well, MTT colorimetric assay; the paper reports the IC50 at 6, 12 and 24 h separately in mg/mL. All three exposures for one peptide and cell line are recorded and the index builder takes their median, the way the AMP stratum pools the rows of one peptide against one target.
anticancer_bioactivity.species_check: WoRMS 413600 Sinonovacula constricta is accepted; material bought at Beimen market, Zhoushan, Zhejiang, China.
anticancer_bioactivity.verification: Results and Methods parsed from the Europe PMC XML of PMC5865786 on 2026-10-02. CancerPPD 2.0 does not hold this paper.

excluded.record: rAj-Tspin (Cancer Cell Int 2024, Int J Mol Sci 2023)
excluded.reason: The tested material is a soluble recombinant peptide expressed from a synthesized cDNA construct, so the 3.19 team-lead decision on recombinant peptides excludes it.

excluded.record: P6 on DLD-1 (IC50 2.14 ug/mL, its strongest value), SW620 and L02
excluded.reason: DLD-1 has fewer than 30 CancerPPD members with a usable numeric IC50, so no cohort is published for it, and the SW620 (>27 ug/mL) and L02 (>150 ug/mL) values are censored. The strongest measured value of this peptide therefore does not enter the score.

excluded.record: HTDT-6-2-3-2 on NCI-H460 (IC50 0.3686 mg/mL, its strongest value)
excluded.reason: NCI-H460 (CancerPPD spells it NCI-H-460) has fewer than 30 CancerPPD members with a usable numeric IC50, so no cohort is published for it.
DU-145 has fewer than 30 CancerPPD members with a usable numeric IC50, so no cohort is published for it.
An octapeptide from an oyster hydrolysate, but the paper reports immunomodulatory activity on RAW264.7 cells and no anticancer IC50.
The paper works on Haliotis fulgens and Haliotis corrugata, not this species.
